skills.name: gdpr-dsar-response-handling
skills.description: Runs a GDPR Article 15 data subject access request (DSAR / SAR) end to end for a small EU SaaS company. Covers intake logging, the controller-vs-processor check for B2B customer data, proportionate identity verification, the one-month clock and Art. 12(3) extensions, searching product DB, logs, support, CRM, billing and processors, redaction and withholding (third-party data, trade secrets, privileged material), and drafting the response letter with all Art. 15(1)-(2) information. Use when someone says "we got a subject access request", "a user wants all the data we hold on them", "DSAR deadline", "can we extend the SAR", "what do we redact", "verify the requester's ID", or "draft the access request response". Flags bundled erasure, rectification or portability requests but does not process them. Not legal advice; does not cover breaches or regulator complaints.

skills.name: respond-sat-audit-requests-restaurants
skills.description: Prepara la respuesta de un restaurante en México a requerimientos, cartas invitación y auditorías del SAT: revisión de gabinete, visita domiciliaria, revisión electrónica, visita de verificación de CFDI y restricción de CSD. Identifica el tipo de acto y el fundamento del CFF que cita el oficio. Calcula el vencimiento en días hábiles y la ampliación posible. Arma el checklist documental del restaurante: CFDI de ingresos y factura global, conciliación de efectivo, tarjeta y apps de reparto, propinas, nómina, insumos y mermas, contabilidad electrónica y declaraciones. Redacta el escrito para Buzón Tributario u oficialía de partes. Úsala cuando digan «me llegó un requerimiento del SAT», «carta invitación», «oficio de observaciones», «preliquidación», «van a auditar el restaurante», «¿cuántos días tengo para contestar?», «me restringieron el sello». En español. No presenta trámites, no determina créditos definitivos ni sustituye a contador público o abogado fiscalista.

skills.name: write-qa-airbnb-vrbo-listings
skills.description: Drafts and QA-checks Airbnb and Vrbo listing copy for US short-term rental property managers: titles within platform character limits, property descriptions, amenity lists, house rules (quiet hours, occupancy, pets, parties, check-in/out), and public replies to guest reviews that defuse complaints and protect the rating. Use when asked to 'write a listing', 'rewrite my Airbnb title', 'audit this Vrbo listing', 'check for missing disclosures', 'draft house rules', 'fix the amenities list' or 'respond to this bad review'. Flags camera, stairs, pool and noise disclosures, misleading claims and Fair Housing-sensitive wording. Not for pricing, calendars, guest messaging, damage claims, or permit/tax/zoning advice.
